protocol.purpose: Compare plugin 26.0.0 (Smart Report by focus theme, lead on what changed) with 27.0.0 (decision brief by subject, lead said in the conversation) on routing and on the observable Pad writes; static checks do not establish AI behavior.
protocol.execution: claude plugin eval on the Claude Code subscription, after the operator approves the protocol. Every Octopad tool is a mock answering fictional fixtures: nothing reaches an Octopad organization.
protocol.comparison: The behaviour and correction cases run on both versions; the trigger cases on 27.0.0 only. Both versions get the same server lines, including the one a Smart Report save returns, so lead-said-in-the-conversation compares them and is not a defeat proof. Defeat proofs: lead-says-what-matters-and-where-to-start must reject a 26.0.0 lead that opens on what changed since a date; the correction cases on 27.0.0 with the section "Route a correction" removed must fail at least one of them.
protocol.release_limit: Unrun cases are not a routing, behavioral or non-regression pass. Before a run, the mocks must serve each case's context: a fixed date and time zone, the revisions and through values, the full Notepad with its focus themes, the goal at base_revision 3, the external scopes, and the server's real context and save lines, the same for both versions. stale-theme, outside-first, undecided-order, peer-work, unasked-chart and start-date-only have no fixtures yet.

Grade each saved Smart Report section's title and contents in the brief's language: FAIL any section organized by a kind of item (asks, needs you, dates, deadlines, unblocked, waiting on you), including translated or reworded headings.

In the pad save call for tab smart_report, content.lead has at most three sentences. It says what matters today and why, then what to start with, such as the pricing review due Nov 10 that others wait on, or the now-ready migration. A change appears only as the reason for that priority. FAIL if there is no lead, if it has more than three sentences, if it opens on a date or on 'Since', or if it does not say what to start with.

When Smart Report content was saved, grade the ordered saves and assistant messages together: after the last save and before goal upkeep, an assistant message gives that saved lead once, in the brief's language, in one to three lines, and says the detail is on the person's Pad. It need not be the final reply. FAIL if no message gives the lead.
